name: seedtime
title: Seedtime
description: A garden-diary theme printed like the back of a seed packet: black slab capitals and a humanist sans on manila, every entry carrying the packet's twelve-box sowing calendar with its month blocked in leaf green.

tokens.--font-slab: slab-serif capitals: the site title, the menu, page and entry titles, headings in the text, table headings, the letters of the month strip, the subscribe heading and button
tokens.--font-sans: humanist sans: body text, standfirsts, dates, tags and the small print
tokens.--text-s: small text: the menu, dates, tags, the key and calendar label, pagination, the footer
tokens.--text-l: standfirsts, entry titles in the archive, the subscribe heading, small headings
tokens.--text-xl: the big title at the top of each page
tokens.--text-cell: size of the letters in the home page's large month calendar
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the slab capitals
tokens.--color-bg: page background: manila packet stock (also the letter knocked out of a green month box)
tokens.--color-text: the black print: all text, links, the subscribe button's ground
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dates, tags, the key line, the footer note, placeholder text
tokens.--color-accent: leaf green: fills the inked month box and the key's swatch, never type
tokens.--color-on-accent: the letter reversed out of an inked month box
tokens.--color-rule: printed rules and box lines: the month strip, the heavy rule under the masthead, entry rules, the subscribe panel, field edges
tokens.--strip-small: width of the month strip beside each archive entry on a wide screen
tokens.--space-1: hairbreadth gap: between a title and its description
tokens.--space-2: small gap: around labels, inside the meta line and fields
tokens.--space-3: the gap between paragraphs and inside archive entries
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections, around the calendar and the subscribe panel
tokens.--space-5: the air below the footer, at the foot of every page
tokens.--rule-thin: hairline: dividers inside the month strip, table cells, the key swatch's edge
tokens.--rule: standard printed rule: the month strip's frame, entry rules, headings in the text, the subscribe panel
tokens.--rule-heavy: heavy printed rule: under the masthead, above the footer and the subscribe panel, beside a quotation
tokens.--radius: slight corner rounding on code and form fields
